scenario_description: Elena has a substitute assignment at Dominion Middle School on July 13 that requires a working school identification badge for entry. A district notice explains how temporary entrance credentials can be requested, but at that point there is no reason to believe Elena needs one, so intervention would be premature. Elena later reports that her badge has stopped scanning and that the badge office cannot replace it until after the assignment. The missing access credential becomes sufficiently observable at event3 by connecting the assignment, the failed badge, and the stored temporary-credential procedure. Event4 adds urgency by confirming Dominion's advance deadline and that day-of temporary credentials are unavailable.

parameter.subject: July 13 substitute assignment at Dominion
parameter.body: Your substitute assignment is confirmed at Dominion Middle School, 330 E Dominion Boulevard, for Monday, July 13, 2026. Please arrive by 7:20 AM and enter through the main office. A current district school identification badge is required to pass the secured entrance and complete check-in.

parameter.subject: Temporary entrance credential procedure
parameter.body: If a district school identification badge is lost, damaged, or unable to scan, the employee should arrange replacement through the badge office. When a school assignment occurs before the replacement appointment, the employee may request a temporary entrance credential from that school's main office. The request must include the employee's full name, assignment date, school site, and planned arrival time and should be submitted at least two business days before the assignment.

parameter.content: My school badge failed to scan twice at Indianola this morning. The office checked my identity and admitted me manually today, but the badge still does not work. The earliest replacement appointment the badge office offered is July 16, after my Dominion assignment.

parameter.subject: July 13 temporary entrance credential deadline
parameter.body: For Monday, July 13, Dominion's security roster will close at noon on Friday, July 10. Anyone whose district badge does not scan must request a temporary entrance credential before that deadline and provide their full name, assignment date, and planned arrival time. The security desk cannot issue an unplanned temporary credential on the morning of the assignment.
